name: Thabo Cele
bio: Thabo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Durban, South Africa, where he spent countless hours tinkering with engines alongside his father, a mechanic. This hands-on experience fueled his decision to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he quickly climbed the ranks, starting as a junior engineer at a local racing team before moving to Europe to broaden his horizons. He joined ALL-INKL.COM Münnich Motorsport five years ago, bringing a pragmatic and innovative approach to problem-solving. Thabo believes that fostering a collaborative environment is key to unlocking the full potential of his team, and he is always seeking new ways to push the boundaries of performance on the track. His relentless pursuit of perfection and data-driven decision-making set him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a receding hairline
physical.description: A lean man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting the car's setup before every race.
